headline: Stlican Shelf Erupts Anew; Expanse Battle Continues
war_summary: Since the last edition the Stlican Shelf has burst into new motion: ten strategic-base changes appear in the two-hour count and sixty in a day. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest battleground, with four changes in two hours, fourteen in six, and about 9,800 Colonial casualties to 11,200 Warden on the day. Callahan's Passage is absent from the two-hour roster but still logs four changes in six hours, and Stonecradle and Viper Pit each add three in the latest two hours. Farranac Coast reports three changes, all centered on Transient Valley. Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow have grown quiet in the immediate window; DeadLands has recorded no base event since early morning. Enlistment rates are still accelerating fastest at Stlican Shelf, Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle and Viper Pit. Thirty-four victory towns are required and the war remains undecided.
